title: MST Problem
statement: Given two integers N and K, the task is to build an N by N symmetric matrix with zero diagonal whose above-diagonal entries are a permutation of 1 through N(N-1)/2, so that the minimum spanning tree of the complete weighted graph it describes has total weight exactly K. Up to 500 cases have N at most 50 and K at most N cubed; report -1 when impossible.
